description: The Security Console in EMC RSA Authentication Manager 8.2 SP1 P6 and earlier is affected by a blind SQL injection vulnerability. Authenticated malicious users could potentially exploit this vulnerability to read any unencrypted data from the database.

product.name: EMC RSA Authentication Manager 8.2 SP1 P6 and earlier
